consequence.statement: The Traefik Gateway API controller requires the ReferenceGrants RBAC permission to function; if not granted, the controller cannot access ReferenceGrant resources.

assertion.statement: ReferenceGrants RBAC permission is added to the Gateway API Traefik controller in version 3.0.0.
